descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Mumbai puts you in the captain's seat over the real Mumbai.

THE REAL MUMBAI
Built from real satellite imagery, elevation and map data: the Gateway of India and the Taj, CST station, Marine Drive and Back Bay, Haji Ali, the towers of Worli and Lower Parel, Wankhede stadium, the Bandra-Worli Sea Link, the 20 km Atal Setu, Juhu beach, Elephanta and the hills of the national park. Two airports: Mumbai International and Navi Mumbai.

A LIVING CITY
Thousands of cars and taxis on the real roads and across the sea bridges, fishing boats, ferries and ships in the harbour, flamingos on the mudflats, airliners in the sky - and at night, the Queen's Necklace lights up around Back Bay.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your own glass hangar on an island in the harbour, with Colaba across the water at golden hour. Walk around your aircraft, repaint them, wash them, then fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with glass cockpits and cabins you can walk through in flight, a cozy midsize jet with yokes, and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: landings at Mumbai and Navi Mumbai, a coastline run, a Sea Link run, a harbour run past Elephanta, a fighter scramble, a night run along Marine Drive and a Mumbai tour - or just fly, by day, at sunset or at night.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
